canDoYue: 你識話自己唔舒服、講醫生紙、請人頂更，同埋話星期一返。
canDoEn: Say you are not feeling well, mention a doctor's note, ask someone to cover your shift, and say you will be back on Monday.

dialogue.speaker: ines
dialogue.text: Hello, I am calling because I am not feeling well and I cannot start my shift.
dialogue.glossYue: 你好，我打電話因為我唔舒服，上唔到更。
dialogue.say: Hello, I am calling because I am not feeling well and I cannot start my shift.

dialogue.speaker: reid
dialogue.text: I am sorry to hear that. Could you bring a doctor's note when you return?
dialogue.glossYue: 聽到你咁我都唔好意思。你返嚟可唔可以帶醫生紙？
dialogue.say: I am sorry to hear that. Could you bring a doctor's note when you return?

dialogue.speaker: ines
dialogue.text: Yes, I can bring a doctor's note, because the clinic wrote it this morning for me.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以，我可以帶醫生紙，因為診所今朝寫咗畀我。
dialogue.say: Yes, I can bring a doctor's note, because the clinic wrote it this morning for me.

dialogue.speaker: reid
dialogue.text: Who can cover your shift if the shop stays busy while you rest at home?
dialogue.glossYue: 你喺屋企休息、舖頭又忙嗰陣，邊個可以頂你呢更？
dialogue.say: Who can cover your shift if the shop stays busy while you rest at home?

dialogue.speaker: ines
dialogue.text: I can ask a colleague to cover my shift, because the shop stays very busy.
dialogue.glossYue: 我可以請同事頂更，因為舖頭仍然好忙。
dialogue.say: I can ask a colleague to cover my shift, because the shop stays very busy.

dialogue.speaker: reid
dialogue.text: Will you be back on Monday, or will the doctor keep you at home longer?
dialogue.glossYue: 你星期一返到嚟，定係醫生要你再留喺屋企？
dialogue.say: Will you be back on Monday, or will the doctor keep you at home longer?

dialogue.speaker: ines
dialogue.text: I will be back on Monday, because the doctor says I can work by then.
dialogue.glossYue: 我星期一返，因為醫生話到時我可以返工。
dialogue.say: I will be back on Monday, because the doctor says I can work by then.

dialogue.speaker: reid
dialogue.text: Please rest tonight, and we will see you on Monday when your next shift opens.
dialogue.glossYue: 今晚好好休息，你星期一開下一更嗰陣我哋見。
dialogue.say: Please rest tonight, and we will see you on Monday when your next shift opens.
